text:
Javier: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands Q&A — sales is asking for a one-line timeline and ops wants the rollback story. Can leadership confirm high-level windows for: model version pinning + rollout dashboard, Optimize recommendation export/apply flow, and streaming+function-calls GA ETA?

Anika: High-level snapshot to share: pinning + rollout dashboard -> beta mid-August, public beta late-August, GA only after canary (aiming Aug-end). Optimize UI suggestions -> console preview in September; CSV/JSON export + API apply -> rolling out Oct (opt-in). Streaming + function-calls -> feature-flag GA in ~5 weeks (docs + SDK updates will follow).

Mei: Infra caveat: rollout dashboard depends on traffic-split scheduler (ENG-2484). There's an intermittent p99 spike when shards rebalance. I'm pairing with runtime tomorrow AM to triage; if that slips public beta shifts ~2 weeks. Quick repro command I used: ```kubectl -n infra logs deploy/traffic-scheduler | grep rebalance```

Tom: From product comms POV: prefer month-level messaging for customers. Suggested customer blurb (short): "Planned windows: rollout dashboard in late August (beta first), Optimize console preview in Sept, export and opt-in apply in Oct. Exact GA dates will be shared after canary and QA." Use that for now.

Javier: Can someone add the rollback/guardrails summary? Sales wants to paste it into emails.

Anika: Rollback/guardrails (short): rollout dashboard is behind per-org feature flags; we have automated traffic fallback to last-known-good model if p50 or error rate breaches configured thresholds for 5 consecutive minutes. We also gate GA with a staged ramp and automated rollback hooks. Ill add exact PromQLs and dashboard links to the RFC.

Mei: For the Optimize export: initial export formats are CSV/JSON; were not planning a Terraform-native export for v1. One-click apply will be opt-in per-org and requires a small evaluation run (1-3 hours) against a canary dataset.

Tom: Internal one-liner for reps: "Snapshot: Rollout dashboard beta late Aug -> GA after canary; Optimize console preview Sept, export+opt-in apply Oct; streaming+function-calls feature-flag GA in ~5 weeks. Precise dates pending infra gating."

Javier: Perfect. Anika, Mei — please tag docs & CS when the RFC lands so we can prep FAQ and customer emails.
